claims.statement: Eight pipeline statement contracts now retain exact private source frames through all ten original event constructors. Same16-group regression observes original-owner RED10 and current GREEN16; ten consumers751 plus Phase01034 complete1801 GREEN groups. Twenty actual guarded commands supply two4029-file boundaries, changing only PrimitivePipelineRules. Three seeds retain207 original events and135 frames per epoch; private origins grow99 to207. claims.scope: Private sidecar implementation at immutable a076218e9d5591b7e0cbf796774476dd1fc90f61 plus four unchanged authored overlays and the candidate producer replacement. Independent original literal source/argument/plan oracle cumulatively authors scalar intervals, including Unicode/CRLF, ignored statements, repeated text, both hash-index and value-discard constructor branches. Default splitter is called once; original returned-array identity and occurrence index retain authority. Copied/changed/opaque/foreign results and later raw transformations preserve existing events while declining origins. Nested private collectors, exceptions, caller error state, empty/rejected forms and all four array end methods are tested. The corrected mixed probe compares each origin against actual private.events[index]; original constructor/argument references are observed. Original .1.2.0 self-comparison marker remains unchanged and cannot alone establish returned-array identity. Actual equal-valued returned-array copy control preserves original/old self-comparison booleans while rejecting the required relationship. Dedicated earlier direct reference tests keep their own original scope. Complete regular Git populations are conservative supplied-input supersets, not minimal observed IO; exactly one regular producer replacement, equal common overlays and complete content/mode/population guards are independently checked. Complete stdout/stderr, exact commands/producer identities and ordered TAP/nested failure checks are retained. Gitlinks/nonregular metadata are excluded without payload inspection. Read-only host OS/Perl/Python/prove/mdBook are necessary tools; project data stays on the repository volume. Complete final book capture/render is separate; rendered examples are not native executions. Initial live RED capsule is explicitly limited and not promoted over final source-bound capture. No public schema/arguments/lowering/recognition/callback/planner/bridge/gate/hook/storage/dependency or other-repository changes. Canonical full family .1.2.3, remaining scanner producers, executable membership/comments/replacement, arbitrary malicious callbacks, backend admission and global historical audit remain separate.
